text_block_list.text:
One day, Hishi Amazon is practicing her
dance
moves by herself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, something isn't right. I'm not feelin'
the
oomph.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If this was race practice, I would've just
grabbed
someone for some competition,
but... Hang on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's not like there's a rule against havin'

one-on-ones with dancing, right?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I understand you right, you think
having a
dance partner would help you
practice, like
partner running does?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yep. You're pretty good at dancing,
right, Fuji?
You're practically the perfect
partner to have a
dance-off against!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll gladly take you on. It would be
silly of
me to miss such a rare
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text: Squeee! You've got this, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The heck?! Where did they come from?! Did you call them here?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Why, yes. I thought our little
competition would
be all the more
exciting if we had an audience!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Surely you weren't expecting us to
simply sway
about leisurely just because
it's a dance?

Fuji Kiseki glances my way furtively,
signaling her
intention to do her best to
bring out Hishi
Amazon's full potential.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Fine by me! Let's see how long
you can stay
all calm and cool like that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now that's the Hishiama I like to see!
Looks like I
was correct to invite an
audience!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not losin' this! Keep your eyes
peeled, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you know it! I'll knock you and
your
audience right over, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It seems you're properly fired up now,
but I won't
be bested on the stage!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, how was that?! You finally scared
of my full
potential now?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That was pretty good. You were truly
ablaze like
an undulating flame.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama's dancing was so intense... But
when it
comes to footwork, Fuji can't be
beat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, guess I still have a ways to go. It's
not a
proper win if I can't wow the
audience.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, certainly. I need a fair bit of
practice
myself—if I want to exceed your
full potential,
that is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Good! But I'm winnin' next time for sure!

With this experience, Hishi Amazon
brushes up
her dancing—racer style.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's true. We're talkin' about Fuji
here, so I
need to keep my cool!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, looks like you've gotten a real
power-up
from working with your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that?! Hishiama's dancing
totally
rivaled Fuji's!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So they think my dancing's on par with
yours,
huh? Guess this is a draw, then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. But you know, you're starting to
attract
more and more attention as the
days go by.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As an entertainer, I can't allow myself to
be
outdone, neither in racing nor
dancing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you always act so cool 'n'
collected—it's
fun seein' you all fired up!

And so, Hishi Amazon improves her
dance skills
through some friendly
competition.
